shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json AGENTS.md; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui .agents/skills/gravity-ui/*

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 4 -i "chartkit|charts" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50; cat index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; sed -n 485,520p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit version peerDependencies

for v in 8 7 ; do npm view "@gravity-ui/chartkit@$v" version peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tail -30; done; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | tail -c 300; echo; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies --json | tail -12; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 dependencies peerDependenciesMeta --json

npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 @gravity-ui/yagr@^5.0.0 2>&1 | tail -8; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && cat docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls docs/guides plugins plugins/*; rg -n "Required setup|settings|lazy|plugins" ../README.md | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit && sed -n 45,215p README.md; cat build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts build/plugins/yagr/index.d.ts build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts; cat build/plugins/yagr/index.js | head -30; grep -n '"exports"' -A25 package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build && cat plugins/gravity-charts/index.js; cat types/index.d.ts | head -80; cat components/ChartKit.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls components libs; cat libs/settings/settings.d.ts 2>/dev/null
cat components/ChartKit.js | head -80; cat types/widget.d.ts; cat libs/settings/settings.js; sed -n 1,80p plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.d.ts; ls plugins/yagr/renderer
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js | head -80; ls yagr/dist 2>/dev/null | head; ls yagr/dist/docs 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js | head -60; rg -n "interface RawSerieData|type RawSerieData" -A22 yagr/dist/index.d.ts yagr/dist/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls yagr/dist | head -30; rg -n "type: 'datetime'|ChartXAxis = |type ChartXAxis" charts/build/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head; rg -n "export type LineSeries\b|LineSeries<" -A8 charts/build/types/chart/series.d.ts | head -30

cat chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js | sed -n 1,60p; rg -n "RawSerieData" yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -3; rg -n "interface RawSerieData" -A25 yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; ls charts; ls charts/dist | head
sed -n 295,320p yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; sed -n 60,140p chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/utils.js; ls charts/dist/docs; sed -n 1,60p charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md

rg -n "datetime" charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -8; rg -n "xAxis|timestamp" charts/dist/docs/examples.md | head -10; cd .. ; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -3; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Card Text 2>&1 | head -30; rg -n "SegmentedRadioGroup|RadioButton" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Card Text Loader 2>&1 | head -30; rg -n "" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -40; rg -n "interface CardProps|view\??:|theme\??:|type\??:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; rg -n "datetime" -B3 -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | sed -n 1,50p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && rg -n "interface ExtendedSeriesOptions" -A40 yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -70; rg -n "timeMultiplier|interface TooltipOptions|interface LegendOptions" -B1 -A3 yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -50; ls charts/dist/esm 2>/dev/null | head -3; rg -ln "export type ChartData\b" charts/dist | head -3
sed -i '/series: {spanGaps: true},/d' src/chart-widget/adapters.ts && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -25
cat .gitignore; grep -l "uPlot\|gravity-charts" dist/assets/index-*.js | head; rm -rf dist; git status --short
